column1: # comment: "Notation and symbolic system alignments \u2014 SKOS, schema.org, Wikidata. gmeow:SymbolicSystem and gmeow:NotationSystem are registry-independent, first-class information objects. No maintained external vocabulary covers them faithfully; the mappings here are broad-brush discovery links. Domain-specific notations (mathematical, musical, cryptographic) are aligned to Wikidata items by reference. The reified gmeow:NotationSystemUsage relator is canonical \u2014 no 1:1 SSSOM claim exists for it."

column7: RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile is RETAINED, not superseded by lang:Rendering. A profile is the reusable per-notation-system rendering convention — the parameter/loss ledger (gmeow:representableParameter, gmeow:declaredLoss, gmeow:accountsForParameter) plus the FnO gmeow:projectionFunction binding — and lang:Rendering, a reified single-crossing record, holds none of that. The rendering role is re-expressed by reuse: a concrete render is a lang:Rendering of lang:renderingKind lang:renderingNotation whose lang:renderingConvention names this profile and whose lang:renderingPreservation carries a logic:PreservationKind. relatedMatch: profile is the convention a Rendering points at, so lang:Rendering cannot retract onto it — retention is the decision.

DEEPEN / EMBEDDING (isomorphism rung): gmeow:NotationSystem is grafted as a specialization of lang:SignSystem, the structured-notation subkind whose lang:signSystemKind is the individual lang:notationalKind. The former language-vs-notation boundary survives as a kind-individual distinction (lang:notationalKind vs lang:naturalLanguageKind / lang:formalLanguageKind), not a subclass overlap. broadMatch: lang:SignSystem is the broader grounding class.
Wikidata 'notation' (Q2001982) — a system of symbols to represent facts or quantities; a close related match.

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:NotationSystemUsage is RETAINED. It is the reified observation-spine relator binding {entity} × {notation system} × {role} × {period} — WHO uses a notation, WHEN, in what role — an axis orthogonal to lang:Rendering's content→form crossing. A rendering realizes content as a form; a usage records a standpoint-scoped fact of use, and neither supersedes the other. relatedMatch: both concern notation but along disjoint axes; the usage relator is not a crossing.

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:NotationUsageRole is RETAINED. Its values name the FUNCTION a notation serves in a usage (transcription, encoding, representation, cipher, …); lang:RenderingKind names the KIND of a rendering crossing (serialization, prose, transliteration, notation, docs-page). These are different axes — a notation used for transcription may still render under lang:renderingNotation — so the rendering-kind vocabulary cannot retract onto the usage-role vocabulary. relatedMatch: both are open value vocabularies over notation, on disjoint axes.

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:ProjectionFunction (rdfs:subClassOf fno:Function) is RETAINED — it carries FnO executable-transform semantics (a solver-layer render function, P12) that lang:Rendering, a declarative reified crossing, has no term for. The function is the executable hook a lang:Rendering's convention invokes; lang:Rendering names the crossing, never the transform. relatedMatch: related as the render machinery behind a rendering, not superseded.

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:ProjectionLoss is RETAINED. lang:renderingPreservation carries a single coarse logic:PreservationKind grade for a crossing; a ProjectionLoss is the FINE-grained, per-parameter loss individual (each gmeow:accountsForParameter a specific canonical parameter) that the completeness gate reconciles. The per-parameter account is not recoverable from the coarse kind, so the kind cannot retract onto the loss ledger. relatedMatch: ProjectionLoss enumerates the drops that a lossy logic:PreservationKind rolls up.

DEEPEN / EMBEDDING (isomorphism rung): gmeow:SymbolicSystem is grafted as a specialization of lang:SignSystem (rdfs:subClassOf lang:SignSystem in module.ttl), embedding every convention-bearing symbol system into the sign-system reference layer with no loss — a symbolic system IS a sign system, distinguished by lang:signSystemKind and lang:modality rather than a local class ladder. broadMatch: lang:SignSystem is the broader grounding class.
schema.org DefinedTermSet is a set of defined terms — broader and flatter than SymbolicSystem, but the closest surface concept.
Wikidata 'symbol' (Q80071) — the general concept of a symbol, not a specific system; related match only.

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind is RETAINED. It is the DOMAIN axis of a symbol system (mathematical, musical, stenographic, cryptographic, emoji, gesture, …); lang:SignSystemKind is the KIND axis (natural, formal, notational, gestural, tactile). A single notation system carries BOTH — lang:signSystemKind lang:notationalKind AND gmeow:symbolicSystemKind gmeow:symbolicKindMusical — so lang:SignSystemKind cannot retract onto the domain vocabulary. relatedMatch: orthogonal classificatory axes over the same sign systems.
Cryptography (Wikidata Q8789) — broader than notation, but the closest match.
